players.product: High-purity sputtering targets, evaporation materials and PVD consumables (backing plates, crucible liners) for leading-edge logic, memory (incl. HBM) and data storage

quarterly_data.signal: CEO: energy shipments were up more than 20%, driven by new business wins in next-generation energy applications; industrial markets posted strong results across all three segments, led by Performance Materials, as data center build-outs are positively impacting non-residential construction and increasing demand for Materion's beryllium nickel spring material.

CFO: Precision Optics adjusted EBITDA was $6.6 million, or 21.4% of value-added sales, up 206% year-over-year, the first quarter above 20% adjusted EBITDA margin since 2021. CFO: Q2 free cash flow was $59 million from higher earnings and working capital improvements, with approximately 150% cash conversion; Materion is targeting roughly 75% conversion for the full year.
quarterly_data.figure: Precision Optics adjusted EBITDA $6.6 million (21.4%); free cash flow $59 million; ~75% full-year conversion targeted
